intro: Two days, a full field, and a finish worth remembering. The 2026 Founders Tournament is in the books, and it took a lot of people to make it run.

sections.heading: The People Who Made It Run
sections.body:
A huge shout-out to greenskeeper Devin Johnson and clubhouse manager Sheri Bornhoft. Without those two, this tournament simply would not happen.

To the 2026 board — what a tremendous job. These gentlemen worked together, pulled together, and made it a wonderful two-day event.

To Katlin Fetzer, for sitting on top of number eight generating revenue for the course and its projects. Without her and her dedication, a lot of the projects now coming to fruition never would have.

To Scott Kirkwood for helping sign up teams, and to Scott Kirkwood and Larry McConnell for setting the pins both days.

And a big thank-you to Don Nolan for the hole-in-one opportunity at a brand new golf cart.

sections.heading: Stepping Up When It Counted
sections.body: During the tournament we had a medical emergency, and Justin Stone and Jeff Harms stepped in without hesitation. They are tremendous board members, and they are tremendous assets to this community. We cannot thank these two enough for what they do.

sections.heading: Tournament Highlights
sections.body:
Jack Dennis and Leighton Fetzer take the title — the first time in a long while that an F&H member has won this tournament. What a wonderful feat, and what a tremendous score these two turned in.

A huge shout-out to Ron Chino for a hole-in-one on number two.

sections.heading: The Calcutta
sections.body: To all of our Calcutta buyers — what a fantastic turnout and a fun way to spend the evening. We cannot thank you enough. We cannot thank the players enough. And we cannot thank everyone involved in making this tournament run smoothly, wonderfully, and enjoyably.
